tasks_completed.description: Added answers field to completedRequests in permissionHandler.ts
tasks_completed.changes: Added `...(message.answers ? { answers: message.answers } : null)` to the completedRequests entry in updateAgentState callback (line 463). This persists AskUserQuestion answers through the agentState -> server -> app pipeline.
tasks_completed.rationale: Without this, answers were never included in completedRequests, so the app could not recover them after page refresh.

tasks_completed.description: Added answers field to AgentStateSchema in storageTypes.ts
tasks_completed.changes: Added `answers: z.record(z.string(), z.string()).nullish()` to the completedRequests Zod schema object (line 71). This allows the type system to recognize the answers field from agentState.
tasks_completed.rationale: The Zod schema defines the TypeScript type for completedRequests. Without this field, TypeScript would reject `completed.answers` in the reducer.

tasks_completed.description: Added answers field to reducer permission processing
tasks_completed.changes: Added `answers: completed.answers || undefined` in both the new permission creation block (line 513) and the update block (line 523). Also added `answers` to the `needsUpdate` comparison check.
tasks_completed.rationale: The reducer Phase 0 cherry-picks fields from completedRequests into tool.permission. Without adding answers here, they would be lost even if the CLI sent them.

tasks_completed.changes: Removed the module-level `permissionAnswersStore` Map (line 15), the `getPermissionAnswers` export function (lines 18-20), the JSDoc comments (lines 9-14), and the `permissionAnswersStore.set()` call in `sessionAllow` (lines 327-330).
tasks_completed.rationale: The permissionAnswersStore was a temporary fix using in-memory Map that was lost on page refresh. Now that answers flow through CLI -> agentState -> server -> reducer -> tool.permission, this local store is unnecessary.

tasks_completed.changes: Removed `getPermissionAnswers` from the import statement. Simplified savedAnswers recovery to `(tool.result as any)?.answers ?? tool.permission?.answers` (removed the third fallback to getPermissionAnswers).
tasks_completed.rationale: The view now relies on the proper persistence path: tool.result?.answers (from tool completion) or tool.permission?.answers (from agentState completedRequests via reducer).

tasks_completed.description: Reverted reducerTracer.ts to restore isUuidLike function
tasks_completed.changes: Restored the file to its state before commit c8ffd1eb. This re-adds the `isUuidLike()` function (line 117) and the conditional logic (line 285) that processes non-UUID parent references as standalone messages instead of permanently orphaning them.
tasks_completed.rationale: Commit c8ffd1eb removed isUuidLike, causing non-UUID parent references (e.g., CUID2 subagent IDs) to be buffered as orphans indefinitely instead of being processed as standalone messages.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: c8ffd1eb - removed isUuidLike function from reducerTracer.ts
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Issue 2: permissionHandler.ts never included answers in completedRequests, so they were lost on refresh. Issue 3: c8ffd1eb removed isUuidLike check, causing non-UUID parent refs to orphan permanently.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Issue 2: answers now flow CLI->agentState->server->reducer->tool.permission, surviving page refreshes. Issue 3: isUuidLike restored so non-UUID parents are treated as standalone.
